title: maint.event.v1{kind=audit_chain_verify}
description: Phase 8 §8.15.7 — notification emitted by maint.backup.v1 once per hourly cron tick after verifying the opsctl_audit.csv hash chain. ok=true when the chain is intact. Notification-only; no ack expected.

ok.description: True iff the entire chain is intact.

rows_checked.description: Total data rows inspected across all files.

first_break_row.description: 1-based row number of the first chain break; null when ok=true.

break_reason.description: Human-readable description of the first break; null when ok=true.

audit_file_path.description: Path of the active audit CSV that was verified.
